title: Amortization collapse for superchannel divergences
source:
Hirche explicitly left Eq.~\eqref{eq:p68-superchannel-collapse} open while
deriving strong-converse bounds for adaptive superchannel discrimination
\sourcecite{ref:p68-hirche}{Hir23}.
progress:
Hirche used the amortized quantities in
  Eq.~\eqref{eq:p68-superchannel-amortization} to bound nested-adaptive
  superchannel discrimination, and introduced fully amortized variants for
  arbitrary interleavings of superchannel components.  The channel proofs of
  Eqs.~\eqref{eq:p68-channel-max-collapse} and
  \eqref{eq:p68-channel-geometric-collapse} have not been lifted to these
  superchannel settings \sourcecite{ref:p68-hirche}{Hir23}.

comment:
Equation~\eqref{eq:p68-superchannel-collapse} concerns the nested-adaptive
amortization in Eq.~\eqref{eq:p68-superchannel-amortization}.  Whether the
larger fully amortized divergences controlling braided and fully general
strategies collapse is a further, stronger question.
